correctness.rationale: Dirichlet integration gives gamma-coordinate moments and E|sum z_jX_j|^4=gamma(2S^2+|Q|^2)+(beta-3gamma)T, hence K/H=2+|Q|^2/S^2+d_p T/S^2. Independently reduced the digamma derivative to positive summands 8kx/((k+x)(k+3x)(k+5x)), so d_p changes sign exactly at p=2. Nonnegative deficit identities use S^2/n<=T<=S^2 and |Q|^2+S^2-2T=4sum_{i<j}Re(z_i conj z_j)^2>=0. Equality forces equal-modulus phase balance below 2, two equal quadrature coordinates above 2, and aligned phases for maxima. Signed-coordinate-permutation averaging of any candidate Hermitian comparison form makes it a scalar multiple of S without worsening distortion, proving optimal complex-linear Banach–Mazur fourth power Kmax/Kmin. Endpoints p=1,2,infty and n=2 are included.
